item.title: What is ‘cookie stuffing’? Why Bill Gates’ daughter is under fire over the online tactic
item.description: The little-known affiliate marketing practice can give companies credit for sales they didn’t generate, potentially taking commissions from others. Cookie stuffing unfortunately has nothing to do with sugary treats and Thanksgiving dishes. Instead, it’s led to Phoebe Gates—the daughter of Bill and Melinda Gates—being in some trouble. Specifically, Gates, who is the co-founder of Phia, an AI shopping startup, is catching heat for “cookie stuffing.”...

item.title: Pfizer is paying $44 million to settle a Chantix lawsuit. See who could get money
item.description: Millions of dollars are available to eligible Chantix buyers, but consumers have until Sept. 14 to submit a claim. Pharmaceutical company Pfizer has agreed to a $44 million class action settlement over its oral prescription medication Chantix. The drug which was first approved by the FDA in May 2006 and was used to help smokers quit until it was taken off the market in 2021....
